description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Prosperous Pirates with haste.
When the Prosperous Pirates token enters the battlefield, it and Coercive Recruiter trigger.
Resolve the Prosperous Pirates trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.
